en.topic_title: Clockenflap 2026 line-up: Slowdive, Queens of the Stone Age, Hayley Williams, Keshi
en.topic_summary:
Asia’s premier international outdoor music and arts festival Clockenflap has unveiled its initial line-up for this year’s event at the Central Harbourfront Event Space.

















Paramore frontwoman and soloist Hayley Williams, alt-R&B star Keshi, and shoegaze legends Slowdive will headline the festival, held between Friday 4 and Sunday 6 of December.





Queens of the Stone Age. Photo: Clockenflap/Supplied.





Keshi. Photo: Clockenflap/Supplied.





Rockers Queen of the Sto
